title: TRACES: Tagging Reasoning Steps for Adaptive Cost-Efficient Early-Stopping
abstract: arXiv:2604.21057v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The field of Language Reasoning Models (LRMs) has been very active over the past few years with advances in training and inference techniques enabling LRMs to reason longer, and more accurately. However, a growing body of studies show that LRMs are still inefficient, over-generating verification and reflection steps. Additionally, the high-level role of each reasoning step and how different step types contribute to the generation of correct answers, is largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we introduce TRACES (Tagging of the Reasoning steps enabling Adaptive Cost-Efficient early-Stopping), a lightweight framework that tags reasoning steps in real-time, and enable adaptive, cost-efficient early stopping of large-language-model inferences. translated_title: TRACES：为自适应成本高效早期停止标记推理步骤
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.21057v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：语言推理模型（LRMs）领域在过去几年中非常活跃，训练和推理技术的进步使LRMs能够进行更长时间、更准确的推理。然而，越来越多的研究表明，LRMs仍然效率低下，过度生成验证和反思步骤。此外，每个推理步骤的高层角色以及不同步骤类型如何促进正确答案的生成，在很大程度上尚未被充分探索。为解决这一挑战，我们引入了TRACES（推理步骤标记实现自适应成本高效早期停止），一个轻量级框架，可实时标记推理步骤，并实现大型语言模型推理的自适应、成本高效的早期停止。通过监控推理过程中的推理行为，我们发现LRMs在达到正确答案后往往会改变其推理行为。我们证明了对推理行为的监控...
tldr: 本文提出TRACES框架，通过实时标记推理步骤并监控推理行为变化，实现大型语言模型推理的自适应成本高效早期停止，显著提升推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRACES, a lightweight framework that tags reasoning steps in real-time and monitors reasoning behavior shifts to enable adaptive, cost-efficient early stopping for large language model inference, significantly improving reasoning efficiency.
